summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard has continued to block Chinese Coast Guard water-cannon attacks on its vessels during medical evacuations at Ayungin Shoal and in the Luzon Strait, while also confronting the Chinese research vessel Tan Suo Yi Hao that entered the area. Philippine forces repelled five Vietnam-flagged fishing boats near Kota Island and opened an upgraded PCG station on Pag-asa Island, reinforcing its presence on the disputed atoll. The navy conducted passing exercises with Japanese ships, and ASEAN coast guards are working on a common legal framework for maritime security. 176 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Filippinernes kystvakt har fortsatt å blokkere kinesiske kystvakters vannkanonangrep på sine fartøyer under medisinske evakueringer ved Ayungin-skorpen og i Luzon-stredet, samtidig som de har konfrontert det kinesiske forskningsfartøyet Tan Suo Yi Hao som kom inn i området. Filippinske styrker avviste fem fiskebåter under vietnamesisk flagg nær Kota-øya og åpnet en oppgradert PCG-stasjon på Pag-asa-øya, og styrket sin tilstedeværelse på den omstridte atollen. Marinen gjennomførte passasjetrening med japanske skip, og ASEANs kystvakter arbeider med et felles juridisk rammeverk for maritim sikkerhet. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall skjedde i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
